text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: It's unusual for you to be so tired.

text_block_list.text:
Yes... The truth is, Голд Шипп barged
into my
room last night.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
She said that if you pray to the gods
under a
legendary tree late at night,
you'll lose a bunch of
weight.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It's not that I believed her, but I thought
if there
was even the slightest chance it
might be true, it
would be worthwhile,
so I went along.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Yet, in the middle of the search, she
complained
she was bored and turned
back to the dorm.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Yaaawn... If she ever invites me again, I'd do well to turn her down.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин lets out another
elongated
yawn. Clearly, she's endured
quite the long night
out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
